blocks.content: Python supports several GUI libraries. Each has its use cases:

items: Tkinter: Comes built-in. Great for learning and small apps.
Pygame: Best for 2D games and animations.
PyQt / PySide: Advanced, used for professional-grade apps.

blocks.content: We'll be using Tkinter, as it's simple, powerful, and beginner-friendly.
It's perfect for building your first visual applications and games.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
